exposure: Sequential internal fixation strategy and intramedullary nailing with plate augmentation (IMN/PA) for bone reconstruction using the Masquelet technique
cohort: The study included 21 patients (mean age 36.4 years) with infected bone defects of the femoral shaft.
finding: The sequential internal fixation and IMN/PA reconstruction technique for infected femoral shaft bone defects provides excellent mechanical stability, promotes early functional exercise and bone union, and does not increase infection recurrence.
followup_time: Median 22 months (minimum 18 months) after the second stage
